questions.question: What is the key difference between Microsoft 365 Copilot Chat and the licensed Microsoft 365 Copilot?
options: Copilot Chat is grounded in the web, while the licensed Microsoft 365 Copilot can also reason over your work data in Microsoft Graph
Copilot Chat is grounded in your work data, while Microsoft 365 Copilot only uses the web
They are identical except that Microsoft 365 Copilot is faster
Neither product can access web content
questions.explanation: As part of the chat experience, Copilot Chat is grounded in the web. The paid Microsoft 365 Copilot adds grounding in work data such as your files, meetings, emails, and chats.

questions.question: When web grounding is enabled, what does Copilot Chat send to the Bing search service?
options: A short generated search query of a few words, not your entire prompt
Your full original prompt, word for word, every time
Your uploaded files in their entirety
Your username and tenant ID so results can be personalized
questions.explanation: Copilot generates a brief search query from your prompt and sends that to Bing. It does not send your whole prompt, your files, or user and tenant identifiers.

questions.question: Files you upload to Microsoft 365 Copilot Chat are stored in your OneDrive for Business, can be deleted at any time, and are not used to train the model.
options: True
False
questions.explanation: Uploaded files are protected as enterprise data: stored in your OneDrive for Business, deletable by you at any time, and never used to train the underlying models.

questions.question: Select all the ways you can bring your own content into a Copilot Chat prompt.
options: Type or paste the content directly into the chat
Upload a file using the plus button
Drag and drop a file into the chat box
Type / to open the ContextIQ menu and pick a file you can access
Email the file to a special Copilot mailbox address
questions.explanation: You can paste text, upload with the plus button, drag and drop a file, or type / to choose a file through ContextIQ. There is no Copilot email address for adding content.

questions.question: Select all that apply about Microsoft 365 Copilot Chat.
options: It can reason over an uploaded PDF, Word, or Excel file to answer questions or summarize it
It can distill information from multiple web sources into a single answer
It provides linked citations you can follow to verify the answer
Its answers are guaranteed accurate, so you never need to check them
questions.explanation: Copilot Chat can reason over uploaded files and combine several web sources into one cited answer. It is not guaranteed accurate, so you should still verify important results.

questions.question: Where can you see the actual web search queries Copilot Chat sent to Bing for a response?
options: As web search query citations in the response's citation section, available in the thread for 24 hours
They are hidden from users for privacy and never shown
Only the source websites are shown, never the search terms
They stay permanently attached to the saved chat forever
questions.explanation: Copilot surfaces the exact queries it sent as web search query citations in the linked-citation section, and these remain available in the thread for 24 hours.
